lines: n=1023 (vqa_rad 200 + slake 645 + pathvqa 178), Lingshu 7B->32B; strong=judge_ok, cheap legs exact-match.
acc ladder: 7B-greedy=0.518 ~ iid-bo8=0.519 < diverse-full-bo15=0.549 << always-32B=0.673. diverse raises the cheap-leg CEILING (oracle 0.645->0.681) but see below.

COST STRUCTURE (the crux): open-text always-32B is CHEAP (F=4.57 = one 32B fwd) and MORE accurate than any 7B best-of-N leg (iid-bo8 F=16 acc=0.519; diverse-bo15 F=30 acc=0.549). Because the strong model is cheap relative to N cheap draws, ESCALATION dominates spending budget on more/diverser cheap gen.
GLOBAL PARETO ENVELOPE = acc=0.518@F=1.00(7B-greedy) | acc=0.519@F=2.00(iid->Pandora) | acc=0.542@F=2.89(iid->Pandora) | acc=0.568@F=3.25(iid->Pandora) | acc=0.673@F=4.57(always-32B)

(A) Does diverse-gen x Pandora beat the CURRENT bo8+gate on BOTH axes? The stacking DOES beat bo8+gate (which is dominated everywhere), but the win comes from PANDORA, not diverse: at every acc target iid->Pandora reaches it at LOWER FLOPs than diverse-full->Pandora. diverse-full->Pandora is on the global Pareto envelope: NO (never).

(B) Does diverse-gen earn its 1.875x-gen cost? NO. iid-pool+Pandora Pareto-DOMINATES diverse-pool+Pandora at every accuracy [@0.52:iid F=2.0 vs div F=2.1(+0.1), @0.55:iid F=3.3 vs div F=6.2(+3.0), @0.58:iid F=5.0 vs div F=7.9(+2.9), @0.60:iid F=7.0 vs div F=7.9(+0.9), @0.62:iid F=7.4 vs div F=8.1(+0.7), @0.64:iid F=7.4 vs div F=10.4(+3.1), @0.65:iid F=8.0 vs div F=10.9(+2.9)]. The diverse coverage gain does not convert: the pointwise verifier's confident-distractor rate RISES with diversity (0.268->0.301, per diverse_generation_gpu.json), and adaptive-N's early-stop is fundamentally at odds with the full-M-portfolio requirement of the diverse gain.
CEILING check: iid->Pandora peak acc=0.653 vs diverse-full->Pandora peak acc=0.657 (diverse headroom +0.004; within noise, and neither reaches always-32B's 0.673).

RECOMMENDED OPERATING POINTS: (1) max accuracy -> always-32B (F=4.57, acc=0.673): the best-of-N verifier cascade is Pareto-dominated at the top (caps ~0.65). (2) tight compute budget, accept lower acc -> iid->Pandora on the 7B (F=2-3.3 for acc 0.52-0.57). (3) diverse-gen: DO NOT deploy - dominated by iid+Pandora at every point; its 1.875x gen cost is not repaid. Scope: easy-ish 3-dataset open-text where the 32B is strong and cheap; on harder/larger mixtures a greedy->32B router (unified_router: 48-82% of always-32B FLOPs) is the cost lever, not best-of-N.
